    // The signed distance from a point to a capped cone (a conical frustum) centred
    // at the origin with its axis along Y: bottomRadius at y = -halfHeight,
    // topRadius at y = +halfHeight. Equal radii degenerate to a cylinder and a zero
    // radius to a cone with its apex on the axis, so this subsumes both. Exact.
    // Precondition: halfHeight and both radii are non-negative.
    // (IQ: sdCappedCone.)
    DistanceToCappedCone(p: Point3D, halfHeight: Number, bottomRadius: Number, topRadius: Number): Number {
        var q = Vector2D(Vector2D(p.X, p.Z).Magnitude, p.Y);
        var rim = Vector2D(topRadius, halfHeight);
        var taper = Vector2D(topRadius - bottomRadius, 2.0 * halfHeight);
        var capRadius = q.Y < 0.0 ? bottomRadius : topRadius;
        var toCap = Vector2D(q.X - q.X.Min(capRadius), q.Y.Abs - halfHeight);
        var toSide = q - rim + taper * ((rim - q).Dot(taper) / taper.LengthSquared).Clamp(0.0, 1.0);
        var inside = toSide.X < 0.0 && toCap.Y < 0.0;
        return toCap.LengthSquared.Min(toSide.LengthSquared).Sqrt * (inside ? -1.0 : 1.0);
    }
